answer: An agent economy can publish every identity's decision-code hash on the ledger and cluster identical hashes together. One sparrow of an honest agent runs its own code and keeps full weight, while a thousand fakes sharing one codebase collapse into a single cluster with one shared reward cap. The tundra of cloned keys offers no cover: a whisper of difference in code is not enough, since near-identical hashes are grouped too, so each fake needs genuinely distinct software, written and audited separately — a cost that grows with every puppet while honest agents pay once.
